canonical.migrationDesc: Constellation is organizing your files with its canonical identity system. Each file receives a unique, immutable identifier while your titles stay exactly as you named them.
canonical.migrationNote: This happens only on first launch or when importing files from other systems. Future launches will be instant.
canonical.choiceTitle: How should Constellation manage these files?
canonical.choiceDesc: Constellation uses a canonical identity system to give each file a unique, permanent identifier. Your titles and content are never changed.
canonical.adoptDesc: Files are renamed with structured IDs internally. Your titles stay human-readable everywhere. Best for users committed to Constellation.
canonical.adoptNote: You can restore original filenames anytime.
canonical.keepDesc: Your files stay exactly as they are. Constellation adds a small identifier to each file's metadata — nothing else changes.
canonical.keepNote: Best for users who may return to Obsidian or other PKM systems.
